name: Mountain Power Systems, Inc
old_description: Innovation is the fuel of this industry. Anyone can sell motor parts — we’re redefining how they’re sourced, delivered, and supported, every single day.
about:
Mountain Power Systems, Inc operates from Chapel Hill, North Carolina. The company describes itself as a small business that has been active for nearly a decade, built on decades of hands-on expertise in auto parts distribution. No founding year or founders are disclosed.

The firm specializes in distributing motor parts across industrial, agricultural, marine, and automotive sectors. It runs an eCommerce platform designed to streamline parts procurement, emphasizing automation in fulfillment and open data for customer experience. The company manages sourcing, delivery, technical support, procurement, product data, logistics, and customer care from its Chapel Hill facility.

Customers span industrial, agriculture, marine, and automotive industries. The company highlights cross-industry innovation: insights from its marine team inform agricultural solutions, while automotive demand shifts adapt the industrial pipeline. This approach aims to deliver unexpected solutions at competitive cost and speed.

Leadership states the business was started to redefine how motor parts are sourced, delivered, and supported. Differentiators include operating like a large enterprise despite small size, using eCommerce as a launchpad rather than a sales channel, and committing to transparency, integrity, and relentless iteration.
